name: claude-code-handoff
description: Cowork-installable port of Sting25/claude-code-handoff (MIT, Christopher Chadwick). Auto-snapshot session state to .claude/handoff_current.md on session exit; auto-load it on the next session start. Plus /handoff for manual invocation at clean boundaries. Snapshot logic and skill spec are upstream's; this port adds the plugin manifest, hooks/hooks.json wiring, an atomic mkdir-based lock to replace flock, and a Perl JSON::PP helper to replace jq. See repo CREDITS.md for full attribution.
